name: replica-id-byte-ordering
description: Two replicas whose ids are ordered differently by unsigned big-endian byte comparison than by System.Guid.CompareTo, inserting concurrently at the same position.

expected.rationale: PROJECT_SPEC.md section 5: ElementId compares by unsigned big-endian bytes, so 01... precedes ff... and 'a' comes first. System.Guid.CompareTo reads the first group as a signed Int32, making ff... negative and therefore first, which would yield 'ba'. Both elements share a left origin (start) and right origin (end), so Def. 4 condition (3) fixes the answer.
